clubs.name: Basketball Club
clubs.description: The university basketball team and community. Regular training sessions, team selection and matches in student leagues.

clubs.name: Volleyball Club
clubs.description: Volleyball for men and women of every level. We train together and run internal championships.

clubs.name: Running Club
clubs.description: A community of runners. Morning runs, marathon preparation and city races together.

clubs.name: Cycling Club
clubs.description: For everyone who loves two wheels. Weekend rides around the city and longer routes outside the city.

clubs.name: Calisthenics Club
clubs.description: Bodyweight training on bars and rings. We learn basic and advanced street-workout elements step by step.

clubs.name: Arm-Wrestling Club
clubs.description: Arm-wrestling club focused on grip strength, endurance and competition technique.

clubs.name: Table Tennis
clubs.description: Free games between classes and regular table tennis tournaments for students and staff.

clubs.name: Cheerleading
clubs.description: The official support squad of the university sports teams. Dance, acrobatics and performances at university events.

clubs.name: Student Orchestra
clubs.description: An orchestra of Kazakh national and classical instruments that performs at major university and city events.

clubs.name: Student Choir
clubs.description: Academic and pop vocal ensemble. Voice training, harmony singing and stage performances.

clubs.name: Music Club
clubs.description: Bands, solo artists and acoustic nights, with access to the university recording studio.

clubs.name: Dance Club
clubs.description: The dance family of the campus: hip-hop, high heels, K-pop, contemporary and national dance.

clubs.name: Anime Club
clubs.description: A community for anime, manga and geek culture fans. Screenings, themed quizzes and cosplay events.

clubs.name: KCA (Korean Culture Association)

clubs.name: JCA (Japan Culture Association)
clubs.description: Japanese culture on campus: speaking practice, calligraphy, tea meetings and festivals.

clubs.name: ART Club
clubs.description: A studio for visual art: painting, sketching, digital art, murals and exhibitions on campus.

clubs.name: TYF.Media
clubs.description: An independent student media team creating articles, photo shoots, podcasts and short videos.

clubs.name: Campus Live
clubs.description: The official video channel of the university. Reports, interviews and coverage of all main events.

clubs.name: GDSC (Google Developer Student Club)

clubs.name: AWS 3C

clubs.name: Electronics Club
clubs.description: Practical electronics: soldering, Arduino and STM32 microcontrollers, drones and smart devices.

clubs.name: SEDS Student Chapter
clubs.description: Space engineering projects: model rockets, small satellites and CubeSat programming.

clubs.name: SIAM Student Chapter
clubs.description: Applied mathematics, algorithms, data analysis and student research papers.

clubs.name: Chess Club
clubs.description: Chess games, analysis of classic matches, blitz tournaments and inter-university championships.

clubs.name: Game-Dev
clubs.description: The full game development cycle: game design, 3D modelling, programming in Unity and Unreal.

clubs.name: Coffee-Philo
clubs.description: Relaxed discussions about philosophy, psychology, society and books over a cup of coffee.

clubs.name: Intellectum Games

clubs.name: Board Games
clubs.description: A large collection of board games and evenings of strategy, deduction and party games.

clubs.name: TEDx Campus Team
clubs.description: The licensed TEDx team that finds speakers with ideas worth spreading and organises conferences.

clubs.name: Cooking Club
clubs.description: Cooking master classes, recipe exchanges, culinary battles and tasting events.

clubs.name: Esports Club
clubs.description: The official esports community. Tournaments and streams in CS2, Dota 2, Valorant and EA FC.

clubs.name: Mafia Club
clubs.description: Tournament-style Mafia games that develop deduction, public speaking and reading people.

clubs.name: Volunteers Club
clubs.description: The student volunteer corps. Support for major forums, eco campaigns and charity projects.

clubs.name: Sanaly Urpaq

clubs.name: Jurek Charity
clubs.description: A student charity that raises funds for people in need and visits orphanages and shelters.

clubs.name: MUN (Model United Nations)
clubs.description: Simulations of UN sessions where students represent countries and debate global issues in English.

clubs.name: LOGOS
clubs.description: A classic debate club using parliamentary formats to develop argumentation and critical thinking.

clubs.name: Ombudsman
clubs.description: Protects student rights and helps resolve academic and everyday disputes with the administration.

clubs.name: Buddy
clubs.description: A mentoring program that helps first-year and international students settle in at the university.

clubs.name: Psyclub
clubs.description: Peer support, talks on mental health, stress and burnout, and group sessions with a psychologist.

clubs.name: Devine
clubs.description: A fashion and style community that organises fashion shows, style talks and photo shoots.

clubs.name: HUSTLE LAB
clubs.description: The student startup lab: turning ideas into business projects, pitch training and investor meetings.
